romans.3.p1.b1.text: What, then, is the advantage of being a Jew? Or what is the value of circumcision?

romans.3.p1.b2.text: Much in every way. First of all, they have been entrusted with the very words of God.

romans.3.p1.b3.text: What if some did not have faith? Will their lack of faith nullify God’s faithfulness?

romans.3.p1.b4.text: Certainly not! Let God be true and every man a liar.

romans.3.p2.b1.text: But if our unrighteousness highlights the righteousness of God, what shall we say? That God is unjust to inflict His wrath on us? I am speaking in human terms.

romans.3.p2.b2.text: Certainly not! In that case, how could God judge the world?

romans.3.p2.b3.text: Why not say, … “Let us do evil that good may result”?

romans.3.p2.b4.text: … as some slanderously claim that we say … Their condemnation is deserved!

romans.3.p3.b1.text: … For we have already made the charge that Jews and Greeks alike are all under sin.

romans.3.p3.b2.text: As it is written: “There is no one righteous, not even one.

romans.3.p3.b3.text: All have turned away, they have together become worthless; there is no one who does good, not even one.”

romans.3.p3.b4.text: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”

romans.3.p4.b1.text: Now we know that whatever the law says, it says to those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be silenced …

romans.3.p4.b2.text: … and the whole world held accountable to God.

romans.3.p4.b3.text: Therefore no one will be justified in His sight by works of the law. For the law merely brings awareness of sin.

romans.3.p5.b1.text: But now, apart from the law, the righteousness of God has been revealed, …

romans.3.p5.b2.text: And this righteousness from God comes through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe. There is no distinction,

romans.3.p5.b3.text: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,

romans.3.p5.b4.text: and are justified freely by His grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus.

romans.3.p6.b1.text: God presented Him as the atoning sacrifice through faith in His blood, in order to demonstrate His righteousness, …

romans.3.p6.b2.text: Where, then, is boasting? It is excluded.

romans.3.p6.b3.text: For we maintain that a man is justified by faith apart from works of the law.

romans.3.p7.b1.text: Is God the God of Jews only? Is He not the God of Gentiles too?

romans.3.p7.b3.text: since there is only one God, who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith.

romans.3.p7.b4.text: Do we, then, nullify the law by this faith? Certainly not! Instead, we uphold the law.
